title: Agent Registry
description: Every agent of the enterprise AI programme with owner, family, lifecycle, rights and risk level, plus how often each agent is used. Step 2 of the agent lifecycle.
insights: Agent Repository lists each registered agent with lifecycle, owner, rights and EU AI Act risk class; agents built in the Agent Studio are added as they arrive.
Agent Usage shows how the registered agents are called, so unused or zombie agents stand out.
The page is cut out of the AI Control Tower by npm run sync:governance-subspaces, so its numbers match the Control Tower.
Figures are illustrative sample data, not live measurements.
prompt: Bundled example: Agent Registry (static, generated from the AI Control Tower page).
